Hero.headline: Next.js apps for streamers.
Hero.lead: I'm Lukas, a fullstack developer in Vienna. I build central logins, dashboards and live overlays, then run all of it on my own servers.

Work.title: Work
Work.intro: Most of these run in production on a self-hosted Dokploy server.

aboutselphy.name: AboutSelphy
aboutselphy.body: A bilingual site with stream schedule, media kit and request management. The media kit is generated as a PDF and pulls reach numbers from the YouTube and Twitch APIs. Security covers CSP with nonce, security headers, JSON-LD and database roles with least privilege.

auth.name: Central login
auth.body: Single sign-on with Discord, Twitch and YouTube. One session works across all subdomains, roles come from Discord server roles, and platform accounts are linked without duplicates. Redirects only go to trusted origins.

social.name: Link page
social.body: A link page with a dashboard and drag-and-drop sorting. Subdomain redirects are defined freely in the database and cached in Redis.

twitch.name: Twitch panel extension
twitch.body: A panel that renders the stream schedule natively in HTML and CSS and loads it from the website's JSON API.

widgets.name: OBS widgets
widgets.body: Chat, alerts, weekly sub goal and credit roll. Subs, gift subs and gift bombs arrive in real time through the Streamer.bot client over WebSocket.

plunderclips.name: PlunderClips
plunderclips.body: Built with OAuth 2.0, EventSub webhooks and moderation tools, deployed with Docker through GitHub Actions. Currently being rebuilt.

Skills.title: Skills
Skills.intro: What I reach for, and what I can pick up quickly.

Path.title: Path
Path.intro: Self-taught first, then a bootcamp, then a product team, now my own projects.

self.title: Independent developer
self.body: Building and running all the projects above on a self-hosted Dokploy setup.

poppies.title: Junior Fullstack Web Developer
poppies.body: Rebuilt a Next.js application as part of a full code modernization. Set up CI/CD with auto-deployment through Caddy on every commit plus automated build tests. Built responsive landing pages with HTML, SCSS and Tailwind together with design and marketing.

codefactory.title: Full Stack Web Developer course
codefactory.body: Finished with 86 of 100 points (certificate no. 1143). Angular, TypeScript, SASS, PHP, Symfony, MySQL, PHPUnit, Jasmine, Scrum and Kanban.

learning.title: Self-study and other work
learning.body: Learned web development on my own. Worked as a digitization specialist at Reisswolf Austria, scanning confidential documents in line with GDPR.

apprenticeship.title: Apprenticeship in media technology
apprenticeship.body: Focused on web design, video and print.

Contact.title: Let's talk
Contact.body: I'm open to junior and mid-level fullstack roles and to freelance projects. German is my native language, my English is B2.
